name: Alert
description: An inline message about the state of a page or section: what happened and what to do next. The tint and the status icon carry the meaning, so it never relies on color alone. A dismissible alert hides itself when its close button is pressed.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text: what to do next. The default slot (children) fills it too.

props.name: color
props.description: The status. Emitted as data-color. error makes the alert role=alert.
props.a11y: error sets role=alert, announced at once; every other color is role=status.

props.name: variant
props.description: soft tints the background; outline suits dense forms; solid is for page-level failures that block work. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: surface
props.description: The alert's surface. Emitted as data-surface. Glass keeps default text and tints only the icon; it falls back to the raised surface under reduced transparency and in high contrast.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon name from the registry. Defaults to the color's status icon: circle-check, triangle-alert, circle-alert or info. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons under the text, such as Upgrade or Update card.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Adds a close button. Pressing it hides the alert (the hidden attribute) and reports open-change.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The close button's accessible name. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Dismiss' ).
props.a11y: The close button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { title: '…', actions: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The alert: role=status, or role=alert for errors.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: The status icon, hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: description
parts.description: Supporting text. A div, so it can hold a list or links.

parts.name: closeTrigger
parts.description: The close button: a ghost, neutral, extra-small icon-only Button in the alert's text color.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Rich supporting text. The default slot fills it too.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The close button was pressed. The alert hides itself; the payload is false.

keyboard.action: Moves through the actions and the close button.
On the close button, dismisses the alert.

requirements: role=alert for errors, role=status otherwise, so a blocking failure is announced at once and the rest politely.
Meaning is carried by the icon and the title, not by color alone; the icon is decorative (aria-hidden).
The close button has an accessible name (translatable, "Dismiss").
Text keeps 4.5:1 on the soft, outline, solid and glass treatments in every theme; in high contrast the soft alert carries an edge.
No colored side border; status comes from the tint and the icon.
The icon, the actions and the close button sit at the start and end in the reading direction, and mirror in RTL.

props.title: Listing published
props.description: Lakeview Lofts is live and visible in search.
